description: Dynamic targeted questioning, guideline-grounded evidence synthesis, and therapy optimization (dose adjustment, substitution, duplicate-therapy cancellation).

samples.user: A patient requests something for a persistent cough. Generate 6 targeted follow-up questions a pharmacist should ask to triage it safely and identify any red flags, ordered by importance.
Summarize the evidence-based first-line management of mild-to-moderate depression in an adult, including the role of psychological therapy and the typical first-line drug class.
A patient with an eGFR of 22 is prescribed gabapentin 600mg three times daily for neuropathic pain. Is this appropriate, and what dose adjustment or action do you recommend?
A pregnant woman in her first trimester is taking ramipril for hypertension that was prescribed before she conceived. Why is this a concern and what therapeutic substitution would you suggest?
A patient stabilised on warfarin is about to start a course of fluconazole for a fungal infection. Identify the interaction, its mechanism, and recommend a management plan.
Review this list for duplicate therapy and recommend an action: sertraline 100mg OD, citalopram 20mg OD, zopiclone 7.5mg nocte PRN, propranolol 40mg BD.
